edits.old: Then the count and the amount of the payments of 2026-12-14 equal the count and the amount of the proceeds rows for 2026-12-14
edits.new:
Then the count and the amount of the payments of 2026-12-14 equal the count and the amount of the proceeds rows for 2026-12-14

  Scenario: AC16 Proceeds row written in rwb_payment only (no legacy criterion; rule BR11)
    Given payment "PAY-90001" matches the installment of "T-0701" on 2026-12-15
    When JOB-07 writes the match
    Then the proceeds row is written in rwb_payment
    Then recovery_case, the route state and the assignment are answered by rwb-case and are not written by rwb-payment

  Scenario Outline: AC17 Error answer of a provided operation (no legacy criterion; problem+json on every non-2xx status)
    Given a request to a provided operation of rwb-payment with <condition>
    When the request is sent
    Then the answer is <status> with a problem+json body

    Examples:
      | condition | status |
      | no valid credential | 401 |
      | a valid credential without the grant the operation needs | 403 |
      | a resource that does not exist | 404 |

  Scenario: AC18 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (no legacy criterion; rule BR13)
    Given a write of rwb-payment was accepted under an idempotency key
    When the same write is sent again under the same idempotency key
    Then the second request gets the answer of the first
    Then no second proceeds row and no second outbox row are written

  Scenario: AC19 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (no legacy criterion; rule BR6)
    Given the rwb-source-data AceDataReady fake delivered the ALS business date 2026-12-15 and JOB-07 consumed it
    When the same AceDataReady event is delivered again
    Then no second matching run is started for 2026-12-15
    Then no second ProceedsMatched or PaymentMissed is written

  Scenario: AC20 Activity retries exhausted without an answer (no legacy criterion; exception X8)
    Given the rwb-case open-case fake does not answer within 2 s on any of the 10 attempts
    When JOB-07 runs for business date 2026-12-14
    Then the activity stops after the 10th attempt on the workflow policy
    Then nothing is written

  Scenario: AC21 Status change the model does not allow is refused (no legacy criterion; status model of rwb-case)
    Given plan "T-0701" is in state "PLAN_CURE_PERIOD"
    When a movement of plan "T-0701" is requested that the status model of rwb-case does not allow
    Then the movement is refused with a problem+json answer
    Then no case movement is recorded
